final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), cross_media AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.bytes_per_ms - c.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_cross_media FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN cross_media AS c WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > c.avg_rate
